units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 4:3">Shek. IV, 3</cite> <he>מוֹתַר שירי וכ׳</he> what remains over of the surplus fund of &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 83b:1">Men. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ הפסח</he> what has not been used of the money (or the animals) dedicated for the Passover sacrifice; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מוֹתְרוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:1:3">Y. Yoma V, beg. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>תנאי ב״ד הוא על המ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="V00720"><he>תנייא</he></cite>) it is a silent agreement of the authorities that surpluses (from sacrificial appropriations) shall be applied to burnt-offerings. Sifra Tsav, Mill., end <he>מוֹתְרֵיהֶם</he> their remnants.
